findings.reason: Untrusted fan RPM value reaches smu_v11_0_set_fan_speed_rpm via the hwmon fan RPM store path for Navi1x/Sienna Cichlid ASICs (registered in navi10_ppt.c:3589 and sienna_cichlid_ppt.c:3199 ppt function tables). Validation at line 1206 checks only the raw input ('if (speed == 0) return -EINVAL;') while the divisor actually used at line 1217 is the fixed-width u32 expression (8 * speed), which wraps to 0 whenever speed > UINT_MAX/8 — the exact missing invariant of the seed (checks validate f's input, not f's output at division width). Sibling implementations in the same snapshot (vega20_thermal.c:194 'speed > UINT_MAX/8', arcturus_ppt.c:1270, smu_v13_0.c:1229) carry the upstream bound, making this the unpatched analogue. Counterevidence checked: the division is a plain u32 '/' that oopses on wrapped-zero (DoS, not memory corruption); reachability requires the hwmon rpm attribute and an smu11 asic using this generic function rather than its own override. This is a user-interface-sourced divisor rather than a firmware-table-sourced one, so it is cross-branch; the firmware-table branch itself (VBIOS/atom, ACPI, EDID, DT parsing divisions) was checked and produced no credible variant.

candidates.reason: smu_v11_0_set_fan_speed_rpm: only 'speed == 0' checked (line 1206); '8 * speed' wraps in u32 and divides at line 1217. Registered for Navi10 (navi10_ppt.c:3589) and Sienna Cichlid (sienna_cichlid_ppt.c:3199).

si_fan_ctrl_set_fan_speed_rpm contains the identical '60 * xclk * 10000 / (8 * speed)' expression but the entire function is inside an '#if 0' dead-code block (lines 6680-6729), so it is not compiled.
atom_op_div (and atom_op_div32 at line 715) explicitly guard 'if (src != 0)' before dividing firmware/interpreter-supplied operands; zero divisors map to 0 results instead of faulting.
do_div(temp, ref_clock) where ref_clock = amdgpu_asic_get_xclk() is a per-ASIC driver-side constant (nonzero), not a raw firmware-table field; polaris10_smumgr.c:933/948 is the same pattern.

do_div(fb_div, ref_freq) with ref_freq = adev->clock.spll.reference_freq, populated from the atombios clock-parse as a fixed reference frequency in 10kHz units; not attacker-influenced and effectively nonzero, unlike a raw table field divisor.
get_fan_speed path divides by tach_status read from CG_TACH_STATUS only inside 'if (tach_status)' guard (zero handled with warning); arcturus_ppt.c:1222 same pattern.

limitations: The firmware-table-divisor branch proper (ACPI methods, SMBIOS, EDID, device-tree properties, EEPROM parses outside drm/amd) was only sampled through AMD VBIOS/powerplay and atom interpreter paths; a full sweep of e.g. drivers/acpi, drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display EDID parsing, and of_property divisions was not completed before finalization.

The reported smu_v11_0.c finding was not confirmed by compilation or runtime: reachability depends on navi10/sienna_cichlid hwmon fan RPM store passing the value unchanged (not re-verified line-by-line in this session) and on no earlier clamp in the smu sysfs layer.

Other do_div/div_u64 sites in drivers/gpu/drm/amd/display/dc (162 helper matches total across AMD dirs) were not all individually triaged; the strongest candidates were prioritized per the twelve-candidate budget.
